rounds.text: Sattva Engineering Construction Ltd trades at a compelling valuation, with a trailing P/E of 7.95x and an EV/EBITDA of 4.63x, both sitting well below their respective sector benchmarks of 15.52x and 8.44x [E1, E6, E11]. The underlying fundamental performance demonstrates robust compounding, featuring a 3-year compounded sales growth of 20% and an extraordinary 3-year compounded profit growth of 131% [E14, E16]. Profitability metrics are equally strong, underscored by a reported ROCE of 22.8%, an ROE of 19.6%, and an operating margin that expanded by 6 percentage points over three years to reach 15% [E12, E13, E22]. The discounted cash flow model suggests a massive intrinsic value disconnect, yielding a margin of safety of 80.8%, while a reverse DCF indicates that the current market price absurdly prices in a -5.0% earnings growth against the 18.0% base case assumption [E36, E37, E38]. Conceded: operating cash flow turned negative at Rs -13 Cr with a cash conversion of -1.00x, and institutional money flow shows a negative change of 3.71 percentage points [E25, E26, E35]. Furthermore, working capital days have stretched from 89.6 days to 139 days, and the stock has experienced a 30% share price decline over the past year [E18, E44].
